name: amfx-us10y-regime-zones-research
description: amFX reproduction (27SEP23 p2): US 10-Year Treasury yield 1962-2023 with three regime annotations. Oil shock/wage-price spiral zone (1975-1985, 8-16%), the normal properly-functioning zone (1960-1975 and 1990-2005, 4-8%), and post-GFC secular stagnation zone (2009-2021, 0-3%). Argues 4.5% yields may be NORMAL, not restrictive. Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: US 10-YEAR YIELD — 60-YEAR REGIME HISTORY (27SEP23 p2)
# =============================================================================
# Brent Donnelly's framing: Which period was the anomaly?
# Three regimes:
#   1. Oil shock, wage-price spiral (1975-1985): 8-16%
#   2. Normal, properly-functioning zone (4-8%): 1960-75, 1990-2005
#   3. Post-GFC secular stagnation (2009-2021): 0-3%
# Conclusion: 4-8% yields = normal capitalism, not a crisis.
# =============================================================================

# US 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity Rate (daily, FRED)
yield_src = economic_indicators(series_id='DGS10')()
yield_10y = ffill(yield_src.result)

idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: US 10-Year Yield with Regime Reference Lines
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='US 10-Year Yield: Which Period Was the Anomaly?',
    category='Regime History',
    y_axis_label='Yield (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US 10Y Yield', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=8.0, title='Oil Shock Zone Floor (8%)', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=4.0, title='Normal Zone Floor (4%)', color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=3.0, title='Stagnation Zone Ceiling (3%)', color=Color.Purple, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=5.86, title='Historical Average (5.86%)', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=yield_10y)
